special-confirm.anchor: Mean of the four confirmed standard plot centers covered by the initial preview, translated by the current whole-field displacement.
notes: Use the initial 2x2 preview. The standalone planting script searches for the green button on the current frame within the bounded region around the standard center plus platform offset, and clicks the matched center. The 17-plot displacements are sample observations.
Reuse the confirmed blank dismiss point from the fertilizer reward screen.
Use only after identifying the overlay and checking that the target is blank on the current screen. Verify dismissal before continuing.

safety: Templates are semantic crops of the target control, not large scene-background crops.
A failed or below-threshold match must never fall back to guessed coordinates.
The fertilizer advanced-button offset is valid only after one-key farming has been cleared and the menu has the normal two-fertilizer layout.
